It can be built from the beginning (bug ?). It is in the [[quarry]] region and near the [[cabin in the woods]]

==Build==
Before you can use the quarry, you first have to build it. The site looks like this:

[[file:Marble quarry 1.png|300px|Site before building the quarry]]

After you build the quarry, you can manually mine [[marble block]]s. The quarry now looks like this:

[[file:Marble quarry 2.png|300px|Site after building the quarry]]

After you unlock [[zombie]]s, you may build a [[zombie marble quarry]] on the workbench near the [[cabin in the woods]] and have your minions work there. This is how it looks, when both zombie quarries are built but only the left one is working:

[[file:Marble quarry 3.png|300px|One zombie working in the marble quarry]]
